bio: The Relais Le Marne occupies the top floor of this building in a verdant setting overlooking the estate’s vineyards, while the ground floor is home to the restaurant. In the latter, a late-19C, brick-vaulted ceiling combines with clean lines and designer-style furniture to create a warm and attractive ambience. The cuisine is regional in flavour and finished with a light modern touch – there’s also a vegetarian tasting menu option. The excellent wine list includes the Mura Mura wines produced on the estate itself....
